technical.title: BedBench exposes major 3D reasoning failures in vision-language models
technical.summary: Researchers introduce BedBench, a benchmark revealing that 16 frontier and open-weight vision-language models struggle significantly with 3D object property reasoning, scoring only 7.2% on per-color counting compared to 93.3% for humans.
technical.why: Understanding VLM limitations in 3D spatial tasks is critical for computer vision engineering in spatial computing and robotics.

technical.title: WorldSketch paradigm uses vision-language models to construct kinematic world models
technical.summary: WorldSketch proposes a new robotic agent paradigm where a vision-language model constructs a minimal kinematic world model by actively querying perception tools, bypassing direct action generation or skill library limitations.
technical.why: This approach offers a novel way to integrate VLMs into robotic control and perception pipelines.

technical.title: JADE enables joint denoising between vision-language models and action experts
technical.summary: JADE introduces a Joint Action Denoiser allowing pretrained vision-language models and diffusion action experts to jointly refine actions at every denoising step by reading noisy action latents alongside visual inputs.
technical.why: Advances vision-language-action architectures for better generalization in out-of-distribution robotic settings.

technical.title: Continuous perception profiling reveals edge vision-language model energy laws
technical.summary: Profiling nine VLMs across edge hardware under continuous perception workloads reveals that visual-prefill energy dominates total consumption, driven primarily by visual-encoder architectural efficiency rather than model scale.
technical.why: Essential for optimizing edge vision-language model deployments and energy consumption.

technical.title: SIMIT framework enables test-time self-improvement for vision-language models
technical.summary: SIMIT is a test-time framework allowing vision-language models to create query-specific training data and improve performance on unlabeled test sets without relying on external models or flawed majority-agreement rewards.
technical.why: Test-time adaptation techniques are increasingly important for deploying robust vision-language systems.

technical.title: ClothDojo simulation platform tackles bimanual garment flattening and folding
technical.summary: ClothDojo uses canonical mesh coordinates encoded as NOCS textures in simulation to generate adaptive manipulation trajectories and evaluate closed-loop policies for bimanual garment tasks.
technical.why: Provides valuable simulation and data generation tools for complex robotic manipulation tasks involving deformable objects.

technical.title: Scale-Free Attention brings O(N log N) complexity to diffusion transformers
technical.summary: Inspired by statistical physics, Scale-Free Attention uses mean pooling, token-count correction, and a spatial hierarchy to achieve O(N log N) complexity in diffusion transformers while preserving fine local interactions.
technical.why: Improves generation quality and efficiency for high-resolution vision transformers.

technical.title: PrimaCons benchmark evaluates cross-primitive consistency in large language models
technical.summary: Introducing PrimaCons, a four-axis benchmark that uncovers systematic consistency violations when large language models are queried using different semantic formats like binary and multiple-choice primitives.
technical.why: Reliable decision-making pipelines depend heavily on consistency across different prompt and query primitives.

technical.title: Zyphra introduces hierarchical attention for subquadratic language model scaling
technical.summary: Zyphra Hierarchical Attention is a tree-indexed sparse attention method that retrofits frozen LLMs with 4B tokens of distillation, matching dense attention performance on reasoning and retrieval benchmarks.
technical.why: Efficient attention mechanisms are vital for reducing computational overhead in large AI models.

technical.title: Multi-agent engineering assistant built with Amazon Nova and Bedrock
technical.summary: A guide details how to build a multi-agent engineering assistant using Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings and Bedrock AgentCore to compress aerospace component evaluation times.
technical.why: Demonstrates practical enterprise multimodal embedding workflows for complex engineering evaluations.

business.title: Global venture funding hit $59 billion in October due to DeepSeek
business.summary: Global venture funding in October reached $59 billion, marking a 45% year-over-year increase per Crunchbase data. This surge was largely driven by a record-setting $15.9 billion funding round for China's DeepSeek.
business.why: Massive capital inflows into foundational models shape the competitive landscape for AI infrastructure.

business.title: South Korea targets sovereign AI model in record new budget
business.summary: South Korea's 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, including a 21.3 trillion won investment targeting semiconductors, physical AI, and AI data centers to build a sovereign AI model.
business.why: Government-backed sovereign AI initiatives affect regional hardware demand and market opportunities.

business.title: Reverse game theory proposed as new method to keep AI agents in check
business.summary: Safety researchers are exploring reverse game theory, an approach designed to incentivize powerful AI models to follow rules and remain aligned with human desires.
business.why: Agentic safety and alignment frameworks are critical for deploying reliable autonomous systems.

business.title: The New York Times sues Brave over AI scraping and paywalls
business.summary: The New York Times and a group of publications filed lawsuits against the maker of the Brave web browser over alleged unlawful web scraping for AI training and paywall bypassing.
business.why: Copyright litigation over training data sets legal precedents for web scraping and data acquisition.

business.title: Omen AI acquires Aquatic Labs in a $16 million deal
business.summary: Two startups tackling the data center water problem are joining forces in a $16 million acquisition, bringing liquid know-how together to address infrastructure challenges.
business.why: Data center resource constraints directly impact the scaling of large-scale AI hardware.

business.title: OpenAI signs four Abu Dhabi agreements across energy and government
business.summary: OpenAI expanded its Abu Dhabi foothold by signing four agreements spanning energy, government, and investment during a meeting between Sam Altman and the emirate's crown prince.
business.why: Geopolitical AI investments and regional partnerships influence global compute availability and market strategy.

business.title: Apple and Palantir shares slide after weaker-than-expected earnings reports
business.summary: Apple shares slid following a weak margin outlook and hints at third-party AI revenue opportunities, while Palantir slumped 6% after earnings failed to impress investors.
business.why: Public market sentiment on AI monetization can drive broader shifts in tech sector valuations.

business.title: Venture capital funding concentrates in massive AI rounds in 2026
business.summary: Record venture funding in 2026 has concentrated in massive AI rounds, while early-stage and seed deal counts decline, continuing a dollars-up-but-deals-down trend according to Crunchbase data.
business.why: Understanding VC investment shifts helps engineers gauge where capital and startup stability lie.

business.title: Trajectory raises $45 million and reaches $300 million valuation
business.summary: The one-year-old startup Trajectory raised $45 million to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts, bringing its valuation to $300 million.
business.why: Lowering the barrier to model training alters enterprise adoption trends for custom AI tools.

business.title: OpenAI pilots Grid Protectors Program for upcoming data center
business.summary: OpenAI announced it will pilot its Grid Protectors Program at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, promising to free up 1,000 megawatts of power during extreme weather.
business.why: Power grid management is a critical bottleneck for scaling future autonomous and AI infrastructure.

models.title: Idol Generates 3D Gaussian Splats From Single Images
models.summary: Idol turns a single image, render, or generated photo of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat with up to a million Gaussians in under 2 seconds. It runs on consumer GPUs using 7.2 GB of VRAM.
models.why: It accelerates 3D computer vision pipelines from monocular inputs.

models.title: Mistral Large 4 Launches as a Trillion-Parameter Multimodal MoE
models.summary: Mistral Large 4 is a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token. It unifies instruction following, reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows while excelling at visual grounding.
models.why: It provides advanced frontier-level multimodal and visual grounding capabilities.

models.title: LiquidAI Unveils LFM3-Omni-2B On-Device Multimodal Model
models.summary: LFM3-Omni-2B is an omni-modal model that understands text, images, video, and audio while answering in text and speech. Designed for on-device use, it replaces separate ASR, VLM, LLM, and TTS pipelines.
models.why: It unifies multi-sensory AI tasks on edge hardware.

models.title: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B Speech and Audio Model
models.summary: Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B is an open-weight offline speech and audio model for transcription in 40 languages. It supports recordings up to one hour with a 65,536-token context and activates roughly 4.3B parameters.
models.why: It offers robust multilingual offline transcription capabilities.

models.title: CCORE Releases Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder Preview for 3D Scenes
models.summary: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder is an early preview of an independent fine-tune exploring small language models for general coding and interactive 3D scene generation using Three.js.
models.why: It demonstrates small language model feasibility for specialized 3D scene creation.

models.title: Baidu Releases Unlimited OCR 2 for Long-Horizon Parsing
models.summary: Unlimited OCR 2 achieves unlimited-horizon document parsing using SR-SWA, accompanied by the new MarathonDocBench benchmark for ultra-long documents.
models.why: It advances document parsing and computer vision data extraction limits.
